name: samplevault

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore: release v%s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('created .env from .env.example — edit it if needed')}"

description: Sample library, auditioning UI, and ephemeral pack builder for Strudel — companion to patternvault
